verdict.rationale: Belvo is an API-first product with an extensive documented public API. The evidence shows an OpenAPI spec reference covering many product areas (Fiscal, Enrichment), API-key onboarding and a Postman collection, and documented pagination, filtering, async workflows, webhooks and an error reference. Community commenters praised the clean API and the ready-made Postman collection, and an llms.txt is published for AI consumption. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI file at a standard path (the probe returned 404 on all candidate openapi.json/swagger.json paths).
